authority_boundary: These are bounded architecture decisions for ChopDot v1 planning. They do not prove runtime integration, deployment, or user reachability.

decisions.name: Parity Product SDK
decisions.capability: High-level typed access to host signing, chains, contracts, cloud storage, Statement Store, local storage, and DotNS.
decisions.authority_boundary: Adapter only; SDK output cannot create membership, organizer authority, payment settlement, or canonical ChopDot history.
decisions.persistence_recovery: Provides local, host, Bulletin-backed cloud, and Statement Store adapters; ChopDot must define which records are authoritative and recoverable.
decisions.network_version: Source commit pinned; exact worktree package family is behind current npm latest and requires aligned compatibility proof.
decisions.license_reuse: Apache-2.0 metadata; adapter use is preferred over copying implementation.
decisions.maintenance_security: Repository pushed 2026-08-21 and includes SECURITY.md; no independent ChopDot security review executed.
prerequisites: Align Product SDK, TrUAPI, and host-test versions as one change
Pass host simulator and real dot-host flows
decisions.falsifier: The aligned family cannot preserve current signer, local storage, and Statement Store behavior in both host and browser fallback.
decisions.next_check: Run a package-family compatibility spike without mixing it with product behavior changes.

decisions.name: TrUAPI host protocol
decisions.capability: Typed low-level protocol between product webviews and Desktop, Mobile, and dot.li hosts.
decisions.authority_boundary: Transport and consent boundary only; product code should normally consume the higher-level Product SDK.
decisions.persistence_recovery: Host methods expose scoped storage and chain services; they do not define ChopDot recovery semantics.
decisions.network_version: Protocol compatibility is minor-version sensitive; current host-test README calls out wire incompatibility across host protocol generations.
decisions.license_reuse: MIT metadata for host-rust-core and host-api-test-sdk.
decisions.maintenance_security: Both repositories were active in the observation window and include security guidance.
prerequisites: A Product SDK gap that cannot be solved upstream or through its public adapter surface
decisions.falsifier: Direct TrUAPI use becomes required for a user-critical host capability unavailable in Product SDK.
decisions.next_check: Keep direct protocol code out of ChopDot v1 until a documented SDK gap exists.

decisions.name: Host API test SDK
decisions.capability: Runs a thin simulated host around a product iframe and exercises signing, storage, chain connections, and Statement Store.
decisions.authority_boundary: Simulator proof is integration evidence, never proof of Desktop, Mobile, or live dot.li behavior.
decisions.network_version: Worktree lock 0.10.0; npm latest observed 0.12.1; upstream README states version alignment matters.
decisions.maintenance_security: Repository pushed 2026-08-21; source and README inspected.
prerequisites: Upgrade only with the aligned Product SDK/TrUAPI family
Retain a separate real-host gate
decisions.falsifier: The simulator diverges materially from the deployed host wire contract.
decisions.next_check: Use it as the fast integration lane, followed by dot-host preview and live gateway checks.

decisions.name: dot.li and Polkadot Desktop host model
decisions.capability: Content-addressed .dot resolution, sandboxed app execution, host-mediated signing, scoped storage, and system-chain access without an app-owned web server for the static product shell.
decisions.authority_boundary: A host can execute and transport ChopDot but cannot silently become membership or product-history authority.
decisions.persistence_recovery: Host-scoped storage and on-chain content are available; cross-device ChopDot recovery remains a separate product requirement.
decisions.network_version: Live census is Products Devnet; inspected dotli-community README also describes Paseo reference behavior, so network assumptions must not be mixed.
decisions.license_reuse: dotli-community AGPL-3.0; Polkadot Desktop GPL-3.0. Use as hosts and pattern references, not copy sources into ChopDot without license review.
decisions.maintenance_security: Both active and include security files; dotli README expressly says reference blueprint, not production hardened.
prerequisites: Keep host protocol behind a ChopDot adapter
Run actual dot.li and Desktop click-through gates
decisions.falsifier: The host cannot reliably preserve origin, signer identity, scoped storage, or required permissions for ChopDot flows.
decisions.next_check: Deploy a static candidate only after current local product and recovery gates pass.

decisions.name: DotNS naming and content resolution
decisions.capability: Maps .dot names to content hashes and enables content-addressed product delivery.
decisions.authority_boundary: Name ownership and content resolution do not establish ChopDot participant, membership, organizer, or payment authority.
decisions.persistence_recovery: Useful for app-version publication and discovery, not user data recovery.
decisions.network_version: Products Devnet registry 0x527b08a640b527a3dae0C4BE04D7344E430B6E50 and content resolver 0x326bdE29315199c814B1c58b431D84D16EA5cE41 observed from deployed DotMetrics network bundle.
decisions.license_reuse: DotNS and DotNS SDK metadata are MIT.
decisions.maintenance_security: Repositories active during observation; contract source inspected, no new audit performed.
prerequisites: Resolve network configuration at build/deploy time
Verify the published CID through the live gateway
decisions.falsifier: Content resolution cannot be pinned or safely rolled back for the target environment.
decisions.next_check: Keep .dot publication as a deployment concern, not a normal-user concept.

decisions.name: Bulletin-backed content storage
decisions.capability: Content-addressed blob publication and retrieval, including SDK cloud-storage adapters and transaction-storage renewal paths.
decisions.authority_boundary: A CID proves referenced bytes, not who has ChopDot authority or whether a business event is accepted.
decisions.persistence_recovery: Retention and renewal are explicit; Bulletin is suitable only with encryption, availability, renewal, and recovery policy proven for each data class.
decisions.network_version: Products Devnet Bulletin genesis 0xe101f0fa4627d29a257645e02be86d80378fea1a2bf8fa6a918d150ebc760a59 observed; source commit separately pinned.
decisions.license_reuse: Bulletin chain GPL-3.0; Product SDK adapter Apache-2.0. Prefer the SDK boundary.
decisions.maintenance_security: Bulletin repository active at observation; no ChopDot confidentiality or retention test executed in this catalog slice.
prerequisites: Encrypt private receipts before publication
Prove retention renewal and missing-data recovery
Define deletion/privacy semantics
decisions.falsifier: Required availability, privacy, deletion, or recovery cannot be met without exposing user plumbing.
decisions.next_check: Run a bounded encrypted-receipt storage and recovery experiment.

decisions.name: Statement Store messaging
decisions.capability: Publish/subscribe transport for small signed statements and host-mediated messaging.
decisions.authority_boundary: Carrier only; signed ChopDot events may travel through it, but the store is not the canonical ledger and receipt does not imply acceptance.
decisions.persistence_recovery: Designed as limited statement distribution rather than durable archival storage; recovery needs another retained event source.
decisions.network_version: Worktree SDK lock 0.6.2 versus npm latest 0.6.5; host and chain compatibility must be aligned.
decisions.license_reuse: SDK Apache-2.0; statement-store-tools GPL-3.0; Polkadot SDK licensing is multi-file and must be reviewed at copied-path level.
decisions.maintenance_security: Current implementation and RFC/source paths inspected; no live ChopDot cross-device test executed here.
prerequisites: Use signed, idempotent envelopes
Keep retained canonical history elsewhere
Test offline, replay, expiry, and duplicate delivery
decisions.falsifier: The transport cannot meet bounded delivery and replay behavior without being mistaken for durable truth.
decisions.next_check: Implement only behind the existing sync transport boundary after recovery contract is locked.

decisions.name: Asset Hub contracts and CDM
decisions.capability: Shared deterministic state, contract calls, and content-addressed contract build/deployment metadata.
decisions.authority_boundary: Contracts may enforce selected shared-state transitions but must not collapse ChopDot's claimed, cleared, approved, and closed money states.
decisions.persistence_recovery: Durable chain state can index commitments; private detail and device recovery remain separate.
decisions.network_version: Products Devnet Asset Hub genesis 0xd6eec26135305a8ad257a20d003357284c8aa03d0bdb2b357ab0a22371e11ef2; exact ChopDot payment adapter currently targets Polkadot Hub TestNet instead.
decisions.license_reuse: CDM Apache-2.0. Donor contracts have mixed GPL/NOASSERTION licenses and need path-specific review.
decisions.maintenance_security: CDM active and tested upstream; no ChopDot contract, audit, or deployment exists from this slice.
prerequisites: Lock the minimal shared-state contract
Threat model and test money-state transitions
Separate deploy/network configuration from product semantics
decisions.falsifier: The contract adds user friction or creates less recoverable authority than participant-signed events.
decisions.next_check: Do not deploy a contract in the next push; first specify the minimum shared-state need and its falsifiers.

decisions.name: Host-scoped local storage
decisions.capability: Per-product local key-value storage across browser and supported hosts.
decisions.authority_boundary: A cache or local projection cannot overwrite participant-signed canonical events.
decisions.persistence_recovery: Good for local-first speed and private device state; insufficient alone for fresh-device recovery.
decisions.network_version: Host capability, not a chain-network guarantee.
decisions.license_reuse: Product SDK Apache-2.0; dotli host AGPL-3.0 implementation is reference-only.
decisions.maintenance_security: SDK host/storage tests and dotli scoped-storage source paths inspected.
prerequisites: Actor-bound namespaces
Idempotent projections
Export/import or remote recovery path
decisions.falsifier: Host boundaries cannot prevent cross-product or cross-actor leakage.
decisions.next_check: Preserve the existing local-first repository boundary while designing fresh-device recovery.

decisions.name: Parity identity backend
decisions.capability: Operated identity/notification services with chain supervision, PostgreSQL coordination, and Statement Store processing.
decisions.authority_boundary: Its existence proves an operated backend is sometimes useful; it does not make that backend the correct ChopDot authority model.
decisions.persistence_recovery: PostgreSQL-backed service state and workers; not a drop-in ChopDot recovery design.
decisions.network_version: Source commit pinned; no deployment or API compatibility with ChopDot verified.
decisions.license_reuse: GPL-3.0; pattern study only unless legal and architecture review approve reuse.
decisions.maintenance_security: Repository active and includes E2E assets; no independent audit conducted.
prerequisites: A measured product requirement that cannot be met through local-first, host, or native adapters
decisions.falsifier: ChopDot requires durable indexed coordination or recovery that native/local rails cannot meet at acceptable UX and reliability.
decisions.next_check: Do not introduce Supabase or clone this service by analogy; decide backend needs responsibility by responsibility.

decisions.name: Polkadot Pay server
decisions.capability: Payment API, QR page, settlement observation, PostgreSQL state, and Redis-backed work.
decisions.authority_boundary: Experimental reference service; cannot substitute for ChopDot's distinct money-state and participant-approval semantics.
decisions.persistence_recovery: Operated PostgreSQL/Redis service, requiring keys and operator responsibility.
decisions.network_version: Source references selectable People-chain observation; no Products Devnet ChopDot integration verified.
decisions.license_reuse: GPL-3.0; upstream explicitly calls it an experimental proof of concept, not an operated Parity service.
decisions.maintenance_security: Security guidance present; no production suitability claim.
prerequisites: ChopDot becomes a merchant payment processor rather than a group money-management product
decisions.falsifier: A later validated payment-collection journey requires hosted QR settlement infrastructure.
decisions.next_check: Borrow lifecycle test ideas, not the backend or product model.

decisions.name: LocalDOT coordination pattern
decisions.capability: Static host-run SPA combining Asset Hub escrow, Bulletin blobs, Statement Store coordination, and host signer injection without its own server.
decisions.authority_boundary: A marketplace escrow reference is not ChopDot membership, organizer, or closeout authority.
decisions.persistence_recovery: Demonstrates multiple native rails, but not ChopDot fresh-device recovery or participant-signed history requirements.
decisions.network_version: Source is a Paseo-oriented donor; live Products Devnet compatibility was not proven.
decisions.license_reuse: GPL-3.0; pattern reference only for the private no-license ChopDot repository.
decisions.maintenance_security: Active source and security guidance inspected; donor is not audited here.
prerequisites: Translate patterns into ChopDot's authority model
Do not copy GPL code without explicit licensing decision
decisions.falsifier: The pattern requires escrow/marketplace semantics that distort the primary ChopDot journey.
decisions.next_check: Use its adapter separation and host tests as reference, not as a template fork.

decisions.name: Mercado escrow and dispute pattern
decisions.capability: Escrow-protected ordering, dispute state, Bulletin evidence, and stablecoin-oriented contract flows.
decisions.authority_boundary: Food-delivery escrow and dispute rules do not define ChopDot group membership or payout approval.
decisions.persistence_recovery: Contract-plus-Bulletin pattern; no ChopDot recovery proof.
decisions.network_version: Paseo deployment artifacts exist in source; Products Devnet runtime not checked.
decisions.license_reuse: GitHub reports NOASSERTION while repository text says GPL-3.0; unresolved metadata conflict means no code reuse.
decisions.maintenance_security: Last source push 2026-07-27; no independent audit.
prerequisites: Resolve license
A validated ChopDot dispute journey needs enforceable escrow
decisions.falsifier: A later product gate proves dispute escrow is central to ChopDot's primary job.
decisions.next_check: Retain only as a research lead for money-state tests.

decisions.name: Survey, feedback, and festival shared-state patterns
decisions.capability: Contracts index CIDs while Bulletin stores larger content; host supplies signing.
decisions.authority_boundary: Indexing a CID or minting an attendance token does not make the referenced content accepted ChopDot truth.
decisions.persistence_recovery: Useful separation of compact shared index from content blobs; retention and private recovery remain open.
decisions.network_version: Source commits pinned; individual live Devnet deployments were not transaction-tested.
decisions.license_reuse: GPL-family donor code; use as pattern evidence only.
decisions.maintenance_security: All selected sources active in the observation window; no independent audit.
prerequisites: Define a minimum ChopDot shared index
Prove private-data and renewal behavior
decisions.falsifier: A signed event log plus local projection meets the same job with less complexity.
decisions.next_check: Use for contract shape comparison after the recovery contract is locked.

decisions.name: Scalable Web3 Storage
decisions.capability: Provider agreements, duration-priced storage, filesystem/S3 layers, checkpoints, and contract interfaces.
decisions.authority_boundary: Storage availability cannot create ChopDot business authority.
decisions.persistence_recovery: Potential longer-duration storage and checkpoint mechanisms, but operational maturity and Products Devnet fit are unproven for ChopDot.
decisions.network_version: Repository contains local and Paseo configuration; no live Products Devnet ChopDot path verified.
decisions.maintenance_security: Active experimental repository with security workflow; no deployed service guarantee.
prerequisites: Bulletin retention or cost demonstrably fails ChopDot needs
A stable Products Devnet provider path exists
decisions.falsifier: It becomes the supported durable storage rail with simpler recovery and acceptable cost.
decisions.next_check: Track, do not put on the v1 critical path.

Pin a source commit
Execute the relevant runtime path
